He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Sally Bakewell on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: Rep. Jim McGovern (D-MA), the top Democrat on the House Rules Committee, says his conversations with constituents are dominated by concerns around the cost of living, arguing voters want Congress focused on lowering prices ahead of the midterm elections. Rep. McGovern, a longtime advocate for normalizing relations with Cuba, says US efforts to economically isolate the country are contributing to severe energy shortages and calls the approach a policy that "constitutes a human rights violation." He also criticizes Trump's attacks on mail-in voting, as the Justice Department asks the Supreme Court to weigh in on a dispute over mail ballots. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

Bloomberg News AI reporter Rachel Metz discussed the acquisition and Bloomberg Tech Host Ed Ludlow discussed his interview with Hugging Face Co-Founder Thomas Wolf. Plus, Jason Tyler, President of Northern Trust Wealth Management talked about the private credit market. Finally, Randall Williams, Bloomberg News Senior Sports Reporter discussed the NBA's suspension of Steve Ballmer. (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: The US and Iran have intensified tit-for-tat military strikes in recent days, remaining locked between ceasefire and all-out war as the White House struggles to end the six-month conflict.

title: Russia Sanctions Bill Stalls in US House Amid Tariff Concerns
title_cn: 由于关税担忧，俄罗斯制裁法案在美国众议院陷入僵局
summary: A Russia sanctions bill overwhelmingly passed by the Senate just last month faces mounting opposition in the US House and is likely stalled at least until the November election, amid worries that the measure would expand President Donald Trump’s tariff powers and drive up oil prices.

title: Zelenskyy Says He’ll Meet Trump Envoys in Kyiv in ‘Coming Days’
title_cn: 泽伦斯基表示他将在“未来几天”在基辅会见特朗普特使
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he would meet with representatives of US President Donald Trump in the coming days and that the envoys would also travel to Russia, signaling a renewed effort to revive long-stalled talks.

title: Kenya’s Ruto Seeks New Investors After Ousting Tata From Magadi
title_cn: 肯尼亚鲁托在将塔塔赶出马加迪后寻求新投资者
summary: Kenyan President William Ruto ordered the ousting of Tata Chemicals Ltd. and is looking for fresh investors to take over its century-old mining rights for minerals that are processed into soda ash.

title: Treasury Targets Tax Exemptions for Schools Over Racial Policies
title_cn: 财政部针对种族政策对学校实行免税
summary: The US Treasury Department escalated an effort to strip schools, including universities, of their special tax-exempt status if they consider race in admissions, scholarships or other areas, a potential blow to the financial stability of hundreds of educational institutions.
